name: Hearthnest Pot
description: A compact lidded woodland cookpot of fitted ceramic and Silverbark Ash trim, shaped to nest directly inside a Hearthlight Brazier's coal chamber. The matched fit retains heat efficiently, runs near-silent in use, and produces almost no signature steam — a deliberate camp vessel for quiet kitchen work in the deep wood, not a generic cookpot.
narrative_effects: Supports cooking, water boiling, and small infusions on a Hearthlight Brazier with reduced fuel demand and visible signature.
Nested fit holds heat between cooking turns; suitable for slow-simmer preparations during a long watch or extended camp.
Pairs with the Hearthlight Brazier as the standard elven low-signature camp kitchen kit.
